summary: This 8-K reports the SEC declaring effective FedEx Freight's Form 10 and the FedEx board declaring a pro rata dividend of 80.1% of FedEx Freight shares to FedEx stockholders. Record date is May 15, 2026; distribution ratio is one share of FDXF for every two FedEx shares. FedEx retains 19.9% and will divest within 24 months via debt exchange or dividends. FedEx Freight will pay a ~$4.1B cash dividend pre-separation funded by $3.7B notes and a term loan. No stockholder action required; FDXF begins trading June 1, 2026 on NYSE. Watch for regulatory conditions and subsequent FedEx share disposals.
